usageNotes: Use this to audit the full subscription key pool managed by PDM — listing every key the caller has access to, along with its binding (remote/node), status, and level. Requires the `System.Audit` privilege; bound entries for remotes where the caller lacks `PRIV_RESOURCE_AUDIT` are silently hidden, so a partial result does not imply an incomplete pool. Check `pending-clear: true` entries to identify keys queued for unbinding that need an Apply or Discard Pending action.

examples.summary: List all subscription keys visible to the current token

tips: A missing `remote`/`node` on an entry means the key is unbound and available for assignment.
Keys with `status: expired` or `status: suspended` are still listed — filter client-side if you only want actionable keys.
The `check-time` field is an epoch timestamp; use it to detect stale data if a key has not been refreshed recently.
Entries with `pending-clear: true` have a queued unbind that has not been applied yet — either apply or discard the pending operation before reassigning the key.
API tokens are allowed (`allowtoken: true`), so a read-only audit token scoped to System.Audit is sufficient for this call.
